summary: Between November 24 and 26, 2025 an unauthorized party may have accessed or downloaded information from the network of Northwest Iowa Community College in Sheldon, Iowa, which found the activity on November 26. The resulting disruption lasted nearly two weeks into December, canceling on-campus classes. The college at first described only technical issues, and in July 2026 notified 16,004 Iowans that names and Social Security numbers may have been taken.
